name: Element
tagline: Secure messaging for teams. Matrix protocol end-to-end encrypted.
shortDescription: Element is the flagship client for the Matrix protocol. End-to-end encrypted messaging, voice, video, file sharing, bridges to Slack/Discord/Telegram. The secure Slack alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

Element is the flagship client for the Matrix open standard. End-to-end encrypted messaging, voice, video calls, file sharing, screen sharing, and bridges to Slack, Discord, Telegram, Signal, WhatsApp, and more.

## Why we recommend it

If you need a secure, self-hostable team chat that doesn't depend on a single vendor, Element + Matrix is the answer. The Matrix protocol is decentralized, end-to-end encrypted, and bridges to other networks.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted team chat with E2E encryption
- Cross-platform messaging (text, voice, video)
- Connecting multiple orgs (federation)
- Replacing Slack for security-conscious teams
installInstructions:
**Docker (self-host Synapse + Element):**
```
docker run -d --name synapse -p 8008:8008 -v synapse_data:/data matrixdotorg/synapse:latest
docker run -d --name element -p 80:80 vectorim/element-web:latest
```

**Cloud:** Element Cloud starts at $5/user/month. Element Matrix Services (managed Synapse) from $5/user/month.
